name: Power Stones
label: Quest
description: Power Stones: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A while ago, I had an incident with the Shadowforge Dwarves. They brought me to Angor Fortress to study two types of strange stones from Uldaman. I discovered that the stones were sustained, stable power sources if treated correctly. It's amazing the things one can find in that old dig site!
Anyway, after I told them the secret of the stones they kicked me out of Angor Fortress and began digging for more in Uldaman.
I want those stones for myself! Bring me both types and I'll pay you plenty!

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the power stones, friend? I have a robotic rodent that needs a power supply...

clips.title: Completion
paras: That's great, you found some! Thanks a lot, friend. You're the most dependable traveler I've met!
I can't wait to try these on some devices I've been tinkering with. I bet that, under the right circumstances, devices powered with these stones will keep going, and going, and going...
